The `fieldkit` CLI does everything the SDKs do, from a terminal or a CI job.

```bash
brew install fieldkit/tap/fieldkit
```

<Aside type="note">
The CLI reads the same [configuration file](/docs/configuration#configuration-file) as the Python SDK.
</Aside>

## fieldkit login

Authenticates the CLI and stores the key in the configuration file.

```shell
fieldkit login [flags]
```

__Flags__
| Long | Short | Description |
| :--- | :---- | :---------- |
| `--api-key` |  | Use this key instead of opening a browser |
| `--profile` | `-p` | Profile to store the key under |
| `--help` |  | help for fieldkit login |

## fieldkit devices list

Lists devices.

```shell
fieldkit devices list [flags]
```

__Flags__
| Long | Short | Description |
| :--- | :---- | :---------- |
| `--label` | `-l` | Filter by label, `key=value`; repeatable |
| `--state` | `-s` | `pending`, `active`, `asleep` or `retired` |
| `--format` | `-f` | `table`, `json` or `yaml` |
| `--help` |  | help for fieldkit devices list |

## fieldkit devices retire

Retires devices.

```shell
fieldkit devices retire [DEVICE]... [flags]
```

__Flags__
| Long | Short | Description |
| :--- | :---- | :---------- |
| `--state` |  | Retire every device in this state |
| `--older-than` |  | With `--state`, only devices in it for longer than this |
| `--yes` | `-y` | Do not ask for confirmation |
| `--help` |  | help for fieldkit devices retire |

## fieldkit devices sync

Asks a device to sync now.

```shell
fieldkit devices sync DEVICE [flags]
```

## fieldkit exports create

Starts an export.

```shell
fieldkit exports create SURVEY [flags]
```

__Flags__
| Long | Short | Description |
| :--- | :---- | :---------- |
| `--format` | `-f` | `csv`, `geojson` or `parquet` |
| `--since` |  | Only submissions received after this date |
| `--wait` | `-w` | Wait for the export and download it |
| `--help` |  | help for fieldkit exports create |
